topic: How does the dual-mode operation of the CTS antenna impact frequency reuse and coverage patterns in Ka-band satellite architectures?
consensus_response: The dual-mode CTS antenna enables flexible frequency reuse, enhancing spectral efficiency by radiating horizontally or vertically polarized fields. Adaptive beamforming optimizes signal strength, mitigates interference, and maintains capacity despite atmospheric conditions and nonlinear effects in high-power amplifiers.
reference_context: Ka-band satellite systems face spectrum scarcity, prompting a shift from C and Ku bands to Ka band for greater bandwidth, albeit with increased susceptibility to weather conditions.
